[Learn more](https://complyadvantage.com/insights/recap-sees-rapid-growth-with-aml-solutions/) Play video ## Pricing FAQs ### How do we define a customer for monitoring purposes? A customer is an individual or business screened and/or monitored against our database. ### How long does it take to access my account after payment? Once you have signed up for the subscription, our team will set you up within 1 business day. ### How do I cancel my subscription? You can cancel at any time by emailing [orders@complyadvantage.com](mailto:%6Fr%64er%73@%63o%6Dply%61dva%6E%74a%67e.com). Your subscription will run to the end of the billing cycle. ### What happens if I hit my monthly monitor allowance? You can continue to use the system. In the next billing cycle, we will charge you for any extra customers monitored outside of your allowance. ### What happens if I don’t need to monitor a customer? You can turn monitoring on or off for any customers at any time. ### How do I increase my subscription allowance? You can increase your subscription package by using the billing dashboard or get in touch via [orders@complyadvantage.com](mailto:%6Fr%64er%73@%63o%6Dply%61dva%6E%74a%67e.com), and we will send you a link to upgrade your package. ### What payment methods do you accept? We accept all major credit cards. ### Will I receive an invoice? You will receive an invoice after each monthly payment and have access to a dashboard to see previous invoices. ### When does billing occur? Payment is due on the date of the initial subscription each month. For example, if your subscription started on May 4, your next invoice will be due June 4. ### Can I use the API? Yes, you can use the API. All functionality is available via the API or case management.
